maintenance.AGENTS.md: Update only when package.json or package-lock.json (dependencies or scripts) change.
maintenance.ARCHITECTURE.md: Update only when physical project structure or core architecture changes.
maintenance.PLAN.md: Update whenever new feature work or refactoring is planned. Write the detailed plan here before writing or executing code.

hooksCheck.prePush: .githooks/pre-push (lint + vitest when present, npm run build gate; bypass via SMART_PARKING_SKIP_HOOKS=1 or --no-verify)
hooksCheck.rule: Do not commit or push with failing hooks unless an explicit bypass was requested; never change core.hooksPath.
